GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down Mid Field 6 Lengths on fence, railed to 5 Lengths turning, shifted out 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide No Cover (7L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 500m. Chasing Six Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Worked home fairly Seven Wide in last 200m. # Wide/OK late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5-6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but never threatening # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After becoming fractious in the barriers and kicking a rear gate, was unloaded and subjected to a pre-race veterinary examination before being deemed suitable to start. Passing the 600m became held up on heels of a runner, which had commenced to weaken, and was unable to be fully tested until being directed out around that runner’s heels approaching the 400m. Whilst being shifted to the outside of another runner near the 200m, momentarily became awkwardly placed close to that runner’s heels and had to be shifted further wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok took sit Settled Down 1-1 4l home turn 3rd Straightened Up 2nd took control 250m for impressive win Stewards jockey dropped his whip 100m # very strong win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 600m commenced to race keenly and shifted out off heels. Raced wide and without cover from that point. Rider dropped his whip after passing the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased to last 7l off, improved 4 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, joined in passing 100m, headed 50m kept on ok late # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After beginning only fairly was hampered by another runner, which shifted out. Jockey reported that his mount laid in under pressure in the straight and did not stretch out comfortably. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be bilaterally lame (2/5) in the forelimbs. Trainer was advised to provide a veterinary clearance prior to the gelding racing or trialling again. VC rec.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Went Forward and sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, pushed 3 Wide and under riding on the corner, bit green in Straight and faded to miss placing # faded late
Jumped Ok rolled forward to face breeze half off, hung a touch turn, Straightened Up half off, joined in 200m, joint lead 100m, headed 50m, kept on strong just no match late # breeze/kept finding
( winkers off ) jumped out ok but very Wide early . Settled Down 7th giving Leader 7 Lengths @ 850m. Hooked Out =widest with runner-up, home Just Ok never a serious threat # bit wide/just ok
Jumped Ok eased back 5-6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground without threatening # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re gelding settling further back, jockey reported he anticipated mount settling in a forward position with cover. He said that after beginning only fairly, it became apparent his mount would be caught wide, so he elected to direct it behind runners to obtain cover, resulting in gelding settling further back than anticipated at the rear of the field. He stated that his mount travelled reasonably well in this position throughout the early and middle stages, however, after angling the gelding out around heels approaching the 200m, it responded only fairly in run to line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly bumped Ridden Along Quickly Recovered Mid Field 5l home turn 5l Good Run Through loomed as winner died on run very late # Good for similar
